liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Sugar Magnolia** (3 reviews): Following the Cryptical reprise, the first-ever Sugar Magnolia is rough but interesting at a slower tempo; Reviewer calls it the worst Sugar Magnolia ever, though the band improved it in later years [5][9][10]
- **Silver Threads And Golden Needles** (1 review): Bob's vocal is nice, but the playing is ragged and Phil's harmonies are off [6]
- **Friend Of The Devil** (1 review): Played at a quick pace and judged brilliant [6]
- **Me And My Uncle** (1 review): Played a little slower than usual and in a very casual manner [8]
- **The Other One** (1 review): The Cryptical, drums, Other One, Cryptical sequence is called a highlight of the show [14]
- **Main Ten jam** (1 review): The Main Ten sounds a lot like Playing sneaky, like hearing songwriting in progress [9]
- **It's A Man's, Man's, Man's World** (1 review): This version of It's A Man's World is named a highlight [14]
- **Good Lovin'** (1 review): The Good Lovin' into drums and back is fabulous, with layers of melodic improvisation [5]

## The recordings

- **gd70-06-07.sbd.clevenger.fix-98.6185.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 30 songs; 129 min; rated 4/5 by 10 [1]
- **gd70-06-07.sbd.hollister.98.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 26 songs; 134 min; rated 4.13/5 by 23 [2]. Said about its sound: Sound is very good with some hiss and tape warble; Sound is excellent, especially on the acoustic first set; Sound is bass-heavy and warbly at times, but not too bad [6][7][12][13]
- **gd1970-06-07.132325.bear.wise.flac16**: source not stated; 25 songs; 134 min; rated 4.19/5 by 16 [3]

## Around the show

- The Fillmore West (the Carousel) was built in the swing era specifically for sound [11]
- Banter on stage is a charming feature of this show [13]
- The June run introduced San Francisco to the 'Evening With The Grateful Dead' concept [17]
- Reviewer says it is not the best show of 1970 but still worth downloading [5]
- Reviewer says it is nowhere near the best 1970 show [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd70-06-07.sbd.clevenger.fix-98.6185.shnf**: source: unknown [1]
- **gd70-06-07.sbd.hollister.98.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by David Hollister; source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Transfer chain: master reel to cassette, DAT, ZA2, SoundForge, CD Architect, CD, EAC, then shn; Splices were made in Casey Jones, It's A Man's World and Cumberland Blues; CD seeded by D. Hollister [2]
- **gd1970-06-07.132325.bear.wise.flac16**: taped by Bear; transferred by Dick Latvala and Jim Wise; source: flac16/48kHz ; 7 Inch Half Track Reel Master @ 7.5 ips(Recorded In Venue By Bear on a Sony 770 Reel 2 Reel)- 1st Generation Cassettes (TDK SA-X 100's) Taped By… [3]
